title: WebMCP tool manifest
description: Single source of truth for a WebMCP host manifest, shared by Django profiles and static pages. The canonical parameter object is inputSchema; parameters and input_schema are accepted aliases but only one may be set. register.js accepts all three keys and requires exactly one. annotations.debugging is intentionally not allowed (issue #9). A consequential tool must set enabled explicitly (true or false). subscribe_newsletter and other subscribe_* tools stay consequential and ship enabled false unless the host opts in (issue #3). Unregister is AbortController / { signal } on registerTool, not unregisterTool (issue #11). This schema does not execute tools and is not a live-page CRUD API.

profile.description: Built-in profile name. Host-specific names are rejected unless the validator is given them explicitly. Keep this enum aligned with ais_webmcp.profiles.

version.description: Manifest content version. Quote the value in YAML so it stays a string ("1", not 1).

id.description: Stable WebMCP tool token. register.js maps id to registerTool name. Required when name is a human label.

name.description: Human-readable label (register.js title when it differs from id). If id is omitted, name itself must be the stable token.

consequential.description: Side-effecting tool. Defaults to false when omitted. Does not by itself enable the tool.

enabled.description: Explicit host opt-in. Required when consequential is true. false is valid and is the shipped default for subscribe_newsletter.

oneSchemaKey.description: Exactly one of inputSchema, parameters, input_schema.
